fixes.explanation: Nazarenes? Ooh, I see where your head went, friend. But that name isn't in this verse. Acts 11:26 says, "The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch." I think the folks who got that new name had to double-check their own name tags, and I bet they were just as surprised as you are.

Samaria? Friend, I looked through these verses like I was hunting for the last chocolate chip in the bowl, and Samaria is NOT in there. The disciples in Antioch decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea (Acts 11:29). Then they sent their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul (Acts 11:30). So the gifts travel to Judea, and that's the whole delivery route.
